---
title: "hpa_quarto"
author: "Joel Lai"
---
I am going to calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain - that is, the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus - regions in human, pig and mouse.

Human
```{r}
total_elevated_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_elevated_human)
```

Mouse
```{r}
total_elevated_mouse <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_elevated_mouse)
```

Pig
```{r}
total_elevated_pig <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_elevated_pig)
```


human had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
